gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ruluko: Ruluko reads friendly and open, with broad rounded bowls that never crowd the letter. Balsamiq Sans sits above it in a bold, uniform-weight hand, and the two share a relaxed, curvy ease.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sansation: Balsamiq Sans draws every letter in one steady stroke, bold and stencil-like. Sansation follows with a smooth, approachable sans-serif line where the curves turn in without any pooling.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sarabun: Approachable is the first word for Sarabun, whose wide channel into each bowl keeps the text easy going. And Balsamiq Sans brings the expressive weight on top, so the pair has loud and quiet in one frame.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sarala: Balsamiq Sans holds one constant weight with no pinched curves anywhere, which gives its headings a bold, hand-cut look. Sarala is clear and contemporary beneath it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Balsamiq Sans has round, bold letters whose rims match the stems, giving headings a chunky, expressive feel. Sawarabi Gothic keeps its sans text quieter, with open jaws on every curved stroke that let the page breathe.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-shanti: Balsamiq Sans sets bold letters with no thicker or thinner strokes, a loud and expressive display voice up top. Shanti stays modern and tidy, its generous e giving the text a smooth flow.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-shippori-antique: Chunky, hand-cut and loud: that's Balsamiq Sans, with its constant weight and smooth curves. Shippori Antique settles underneath it as a monoweight sans-serif, its open bowls tipped toward you.
Bold and stencil-cut, Balsamiq Sans draws attention with a constant weight and no pinched curves anywhere. Shippori Antique B1 stays plainer, letting daylight through every curve.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro keeps its text modern and plain sans, with open aperture curves running through the entire alphabet from start to finish. Balsamiq Sans does the bold, expressive display work while SN Pro handles the reading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-snippet: Snippet reads friendly and workmanlike, its crescent-wrench c and wire-bent look carried across each word. Balsamiq Sans is the bolder partner, and the stencil-cut weight against that wiry line is what makes the pair.
